Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
The water is cold enough to hurt your teeth. Downstream the creek bends out of sight, and you want to follow it. That's the problem with creeks.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 9 people, 7 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
The creek braids around gravel bars. Crawdads flick backward into the shadows of rocks.

You see smoke on the horizon. Emberhold — 9 people, 7 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
🪨 Ruth pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (5 stone now.)
Ruth doesn't bother arguing anymore. By dusk the Fish crews are taking orders from them, and nobody quite remembers when it changed.

🌿 Ruth checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~13 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the water run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
💧 Ruth returns with 7L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.

Something big drank here recently — the mud is churned to soup on the far bank. You drink from the near side, upstream of whatever it was.
